Rectal swabs were collected from four consenting patients
In mid-December 2018, an adult with a history of recurrent urinary tract infections was admitted to a Wyoming hospital
WDH began an investigation using CDC guidance to determine where the patient might have acquired the microorganism

methods_quotes.q: Colistin susceptibility testing by broth microdilution found that the minimum inhibitory concentration was >4 μ g/mL
The plasmid-mediated mcr-1 colistin resistance gene was detected using a CDC-developed multiplex real-time polymerase chain reaction assay
Six patients whose hospitalizations overlapped with the index patient's by >1 day on the same hospital unit were identified.
